_about: Real Google News headlines from the discovery runs of 2026-09-21, -09-28 and -10-05 — the runs that filed verbs and prepositions as companies. 'want' lists the names a reviewer would accept; an empty list means the headline names no company, so anything extracted from it is junk. flowtest requires zero junk and recall at or above recall_floor. The last nine are hand-written cases carried over from the two earlier fixes (#111, #120), kept so neither regression can come back.
